mechanics.claim: Purge attacks prioritize the marked enemy champion and cannot critically strike.
mechanics.quote: prioritizing ''marked'' enemy champions and refreshing the ''mark'' with every attack

mechanics.claim: Each shot applies on-hit and on-attack effects, at 50% effectiveness for on-hit/on-attack damage.
mechanics.quote: Each attack applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced to 50% effectiveness.

mechanics.claim: Purge's attacks do not interact with Urgot's normal basic attack timer, so he can attack normally right after it ends.
mechanics.quote: ''Purge's'' attacks do not interact with '''Urgot's''' {{tip|basic attack}} timer.

mechanics.claim: Each shot counts as a separate hit for on-hit trigger effects like Electrocute, Muramana Shock, Eclipse.
mechanics.quote: Each shot counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}, {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.

mechanics.claim: Purge applies Runaan's Hurricane bolts at 100% listed damage on every shot, though on-hit damage from those bolts is still reduced by Purge.
mechanics.quote: ''Purge'' will apply {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} on every shot at 100% of the listed damage.

mechanics.claim: Before max rank, uninterrupted Urgot fires 13 shots total during the duration.
mechanics.quote: Before maximum rank, if continuously attacking without being interrupted or interrupting or canceling the cast, '''Urgot''' will attack 13 times.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after the effect ends (post-effect).
At max rank Purge lasts indefinitely and becomes a toggle.
mechanics.quote: at maximum rank, ''Purge'' lasts indefinitely and becomes a {{sbc|toggled}} ability

mechanics.claim: While firing, Urgot gains 40% slow resist and takes a flat 125 movement speed reduction; this does not affect damage.
